Fig. 3. Qualitative comparison of CVS assessment results. Our ReasonCVS provides correct, criterion-level rationales grounded in specific anatomical evidence, enabling interpretable and traceable clinical reasoning.

Fig. 2. The overview of our ReasonCVS framework for interpretable CVS assessment, consisting of Anatomical Scene Graph Abstraction (ASGA), VLM-driven Sub-criterion Verification, and Rationale-Aware Reasoning Agent. ReasonCVS decomposes CVS assessment into explicit anatomical verification with traceable clinical rationale.
